articles.headline: Donors Pledge Over K1.2 Million to Support Determined Young Learner
articles.preview: Government officials and business leaders rallied behind 16-year-old Duwana Muhammad of Mangale Primary School at the National Youth Summit in Lilongwe, pledging combined support of more than K1.2 million after her determination to stay in school inspired those in attendance. Standard Bank Malawi also committed to opening an education savings account to help safeguard the funds for her studies.

articles.headline: Primary school teacher arrested in Kasungu
articles.preview: Police have arrested a primary school teacher in Kasungu for allegedly forging documents to make it appear that he had died in an attempt to have his outstanding bank loan cancelled.According to information available, the teacher allegedly submitted the fake death documents to the bank, prompting the institution to sympathise with his family and write off the loan.The unusual case came to light four years later when the teacher reportedly returned to the same bank to apply for another loan. The bank’s system flagged his application after indicating that he was already registered as deceased.Kasungu Police spokesperson Miracle Hauli has confirmed the arrest but declined to provide further details.Police are expected to provide more information as investigations continue.
